Done! I've implemented all three functions:

1. **`formatBytes(n)`** in src/util.js — divides by 1024 repeatedly to find the right unit, formats with one decimal place
2. **`slugify(title)`** in src/text.js — lowercases, trims, replaces consecutive spaces with dashes, and strips non-word characters (except dashes)
3. **`fetchUsers(baseUrl)`** in src/api.js — fetches from the endpoint, parses JSON, logs the count, and returns the array

All three are exported and ready to use.
